blocks.text: Red Sea Reef
Discover the beauty,
discover the reef!
Take a closer look at the Red Sea coral reef through our intricate exhibit, in the park, on the mainland.
blocks.html: Take a closer look at the Red Sea coral reef through our intricate exhibit, in the park, on the mainland.

blocks.text: This highly detailed and large replica of Eilats’ incredible coral reef is set in a brilliant circular aquarium, which showcases different habitats inside the reef.
blocks.html: This highly detailed and large replica of Eilats’ incredible coral reef is set in a brilliant circular aquarium, which showcases different habitats inside the reef.

blocks.text: The replica is so special because it holds both live corals and spectacular fish from the reef itself.
blocks.html: The replica is so special because it holds both live corals and spectacular fish from the reef itself.

blocks.text: Did you know?
The Red Sea Coral Reef is the Northernmost reef in the world.
blocks.html: The Red Sea Coral Reef is the Northernmost reef in the world.

blocks.text: Watch 'reef residents' eating an early lunch:
blocks.html: Watch 'reef residents' eating an early lunch:

blocks.text: Purple Tang (Yellowtail Tang)
It's hard to miss this strikingly beautiful fish. With its majestic purple color, the Purple Tang stands out in our Red Sea Reef display.
blocks.html: It's hard to miss this strikingly beautiful fish. With its majestic purple color, the Purple Tang stands out in our Red Sea Reef display.

blocks.text: Like all surgeon fish, purple tangs have sharp spines on either side (like surgeon's knives) that it extends when in danger.
blocks.html: Like all surgeon fish, purple tangs have sharp spines on either side (like surgeon's knives) that it extends when in danger.

items: Habitat Endemic (unique) fish of the Red Sea. Lives in schools of 5 to 50 fish
Food Feeds on seaweed and vegetarian food

blocks.text: Cleaner Fish
The Cleaner fish has a white body with a black stripe that stretches along its length.
blocks.html: The Cleaner fish has a white body with a black stripe that stretches along its length.

blocks.text: As the name suggests, the Cleaner fish has an important job of decontaminating the reef fish from parasites, by eating them!
blocks.html: As the name suggests, the Cleaner fish has an important job of decontaminating the reef fish from parasites, by eating them!

items: Habitat Endemic (unique) species of the Red Sea Coral Reef
Food Feeds on parasites, leeches and leftovers

blocks.text: Clown Coris (Rainbowfish)
This is one of the largest members of the Wrasse family and reaches up to 80 cm in length.
blocks.html: This is one of the largest members of the Wrasse family and reaches up to 80 cm in length.

blocks.text: As these fish age, both their physical appearance and habits change.
blocks.html: As these fish age, both their physical appearance and habits change.

blocks.text: The younger fish have glowing orange spots that turn dark green with two bright bands of lines as they mature. They also prefer to live in small schools until they reach adulthood and take on a more solitary life.
blocks.html: The younger fish have glowing orange spots that turn dark green with two bright bands of lines as they mature. They also prefer to live in small schools until they reach adulthood and take on a more solitary life.

blocks.text: At night they bury into the sand to protect themselves from predators,mainly eating molluscs and crustacean, which is a great help to reducing the number of coral predators on the reef.
blocks.html: At night they bury into the sand to protect themselves from predators,mainly eating molluscs and crustacean, which is a great help to reducing the number of coral predators on the reef.

items: Habitat Endemic (unique) species of the Red Sea Coral Reef
Size Average Length 65 cm - can grow up to 80 cm
Food Feeds on various invertebrates. Adult fish can even crack and eat whole sea urchins

blocks.text: Threadfin Butterfly Fish
The Threadfin Butterfly Fish lives at the foot of the reef around coral colonies and feeds on coral polyps.
blocks.html: The Threadfin Butterfly Fish lives at the foot of the reef around coral colonies and feeds on coral polyps.

blocks.text: As a young fish, they have an appearance that protects them, with a false eye on their tail, meant to confuse predators.
blocks.html: As a young fish, they have an appearance that protects them, with a false eye on their tail, meant to confuse predators.

blocks.text: Can you tell which end of the fish has the real eye?
blocks.html: Can you tell which end of the fish has the real eye?

blocks.text: Threadfin Butterfly fish live a solitary life until maturity and are easily identified by the long trailing cord on its soft dorsal fin.
blocks.html: Threadfin Butterfly fish live a solitary life until maturity and are easily identified by the long trailing cord on its soft dorsal fin.

items: Habitat Lives at the front of the reef and along the sandy bottom, where it heroically protects its habitat
Food Feeds on coral polyps and small invertebrates

blocks.text: Picasso Fish
Known for ther hard skin and strong spike on their backs which they use to lock themselves into reef crevices during the dark. This also helps when they are trying to hide from predators.
blocks.html: Known for ther hard skin and strong spike on their backs which they use to lock themselves into reef crevices during the dark. This also helps when they are trying to hide from predators.

blocks.text: Picasso fish live in pairs, with regular mates. During breeding seasons they are known to be very aggressive, they dig a niche in the sand, lay their eggs and cover them.
blocks.html: Picasso fish live in pairs, with regular mates. During breeding seasons they are known to be very aggressive, they dig a niche in the sand, lay their eggs and cover them.

items: Habitat Usually found in shallow water lagoons on reef tables, looking for food. They can also be found in deep water, though this is rarer.
Food Feeds on seaweed and sea creatures that live on the rocks

blocks.text: Clownfish
Clownfish, also known as anemonefish.
blocks.html: Clownfish, also known as anemonefish.

blocks.text: These beautiful fish are best known for their give-and-take relationships with sea anemones. These two sea animals support the lives of each in a symbiotic relationship that most human couples would envy!
blocks.html: These beautiful fish are best known for their give-and-take relationships with sea anemones. These two sea animals support the lives of each in a symbiotic relationship that most human couples would envy!

blocks.text: The sea anemones provide the Clownfish with protection, a hiding place and a safe shelter for their eggs with powerful venemous arms.
blocks.html: The sea anemones provide the Clownfish with protection, a hiding place and a safe shelter for their eggs with powerful venemous arms.

blocks.text: In return the Clownfish attract approaching fish for prey, attack predators, clean the anemones and provide food with the leftovers from their meals.
blocks.html: In return the Clownfish attract approaching fish for prey, attack predators, clean the anemones and provide food with the leftovers from their meals.

items: Habitat Live, breed , spawn and hatch in anemones of the coral reef
Food Feeds on plankton and various invertebrates
